robots.title: Unitree G1 (29 joints)
robots.maker: Unitree Robotics (model); policies trained with mjlab
robots.summary: The 1.3 m G1 with all 29 joints driven, from mjlab. Two walking policies trained the same way, one with small random shoves and one with shoves twice as strong.
robots.credit: Unitree G1 model: Unitree Robotics, BSD 3-Clause · mjlab: Apache-2.0
robots.licenseNotice: The G1 model and meshes are Unitree Robotics' (BSD 3-Clause; byte-identical to MuJoCo Menagerie's unitree_g1) as distributed with mjlab (Apache-2.0, github.com/mujocolab/mjlab at v1.6.0); the XML here is mjlab's G1 task as simulated, exported by Creature Lab. The two walking policies were trained for Creature Lab with mjlab's own G1 velocity task and are released under Apache-2.0. Creature Lab downloads the meshes on first use; the model and policies are bundled with the license texts beside them.

policies.title: Small-shove policy
policies.summary: mjlab's standard G1 recipe: random pushes of up to 0.5 m/s every 1 to 3 seconds. 1500 training iterations.

policies.title: Strong-shove policy
policies.summary: The same run, then 600 more iterations with pushes of up to 1.0 m/s, twice as strong. 1500 iterations in all.
